**[P2] Resolve qualified identifiers against the bare function entry**

The runner invokes qualified targets as `FunctionName:qualifier`, while `shim-map.json` contains only bare template names. This exact lookup therefore returns `ResourceNotFoundException` even though `FunctionConfigs` deliberately permits the bare configuration to serve any qualifier. Parse the identifier for lookup while preserving its qualifier in the Lambda context, and test qualified durable and non-durable invokes.
